block.createtorquerails.train_engine.too: Lets a train move. Its _rotation speed_ sets how fast the train can go, and every carriage adds stress it has to carry.
Takes rotation through its front and back. At _256 RPM_ the train reaches its full top speed, and slower scales it down.
Each carriage adds _16 SU per RPM_, shared evenly between all of the train's engines. If an engine overstresses, it stops pulling.
block.createtorquerails.creative_train_e: Gives its train full speed with no input needed.
createtorquerails.ponder.train_engine.he: Powering trains with the Train Engine
createtorquerails.ponder.train_engine.te: Trains can't move without a working Train Engine on board
It takes rotation through its front and back, like a shaft
Its RPM sets how fast the train can go. At 64 RPM, it only reaches a quarter of its top speed
At 256 RPM, it reaches its full top speed
Every carriage adds stress it has to carry: 16 SU per RPM, shared evenly between all of the train's engines
If an engine overstresses, it stops pulling
With Engineer's Goggles, the engine shows the train's max speed, and how fast its stress capacity could take it
